title: Nine Inches of Drawing
subtitle: 数学逻辑 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数学逻辑（科学与技术·数学与逻辑）
meta: 主题语境：数学逻辑（科学与技术·数学与逻辑）　|　核心词汇：circle　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 circle 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1948 my mother was sent to draw ① circle she could not close, and she said the drawing was the whole of the lesson. The ② circle, meaning the figure and not the group, was nine inches across and was drawn by whoever came last; circle, she said, is the only thing on a page that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ circle on that page had the same centre, and the ④ circle at the end, meaning the one the master kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever drew properly. Circle, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ circle was the whole of the school, meaning the set of people it carried and not the figure. The ⑥ circle, meaning the people and not any of that, is the only thing in a school that everybody joins and nobody questions; circle, he said, is either something you draw or the only word that means both a figure and a set of people. She said the people are the part they remember.

By 1963 the ⑦ circle had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the centre. The ⑧ circle of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine inches and eleven years of drawing; circle, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ circle I remember is the one at the end, which was drawn in 1968 and is still described as the roundest in the county. A ⑩ circle, my grandmother said in 1973, is the only thing that improves by being drawn; every circle, she said, is a set of people that has agreed to look like a figure. She said the people were the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 圆（指那个图形本身，与那一圈人相对）
C. 固定搭配：draw a circle 画一个圆
D. n. 圆（指那页纸上每一个）
E. n. 圆（指末尾那一个）
F. n. 圈子（抽象：它承载的那群人）
G. n. 那群人（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The circle, meaning the figure and not the group
circle was the whole of the school
the circle had become a number in a report
The circle of the whole thing
A circle, my grandmother said in 1973

answers.why: draw a circle 意为“画一个圆”，1948 年母亲被派去画她合不拢的那个圆。
circle 意为“圆、圆圈”，指那个图形本身而不是那一圈人，直径九英寸，由最后来的人画。
circle 指那页纸上每一个圆，每一个都是同样的圆心。
circle 指末尾那一个（老师保留的那一个），是唯一有人认真画过的。
circle 意为“圈子”，抽象指它承载的那群人，父亲说 circle 就是那所学校的全部。
circle 为抽象用法，指那群人本身，是一所学校里人人都加入、却没人质疑的东西。
circle 意为“圆、圆圈”，到 1963 年这个 circle 成了报告里的一个数字。
circle 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九英寸和十一年的绘制。
circle 意为“圆”，我记得的是末尾那一个，1968 年画过，至今仍被说成全县最圆的。
circle 为抽象总称，祖母说一个圆是唯一会因为被认真绘制而变好的东西。
